$comment: The voices a workspace owner can choose from for their assistant on calls and in previews (job voice-picker, owner decision 28 Oct; Bulbul v3 is dropped). Data, not code: the CATALOGUE is the list of allowed voices, one entry marked default per language (the default is what speaks until the owner chooses). Each entry names its Cartesia voice and a Bulbul v4 Flash FALLBACK voice of the SAME gender (checked on load). Ids are '<language>-<name>'. Add or remove a voice here and render its sample with scripts/voice_catalogue_samples.py. Labels are plain words for the screen. Voice system v2 (29 Oct 2026): native Cartesia voices of both genders in te, en, hi, kn, ta, ml, built by scripts/voice_catalogue_build.py; tags in plain words; recommended = the best three by a speech-to-text round trip. Voice list of 20 Nov 2026: `listed` marks the SHORT LIST the owner sees (two women and two men per language where the catalogue has them); `provider` is cartesia | sarvam (the engine that speaks the voice first; the other one is its fallback of the same language and gender); every listed voice is `to_confirm_by_native_listener` (chosen by documented gender and style, nobody has listened yet). Unlisted entries stay so a stored choice never breaks, but they are ignored (the default speaks). 21 Nov 2026 (owner: "we also need all those from Sarvam and Cartesia"): EVERY voice is listed, the 45 Cartesia voices of scripts/voice_catalogue_build.py and every Bulbul v4 Flash speaker documented for te, hi, kn, en and ta (docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/voices): `gender_source: name` = the docs state no gender, it is read from the speaker's first name and must be confirmed by a listener. Each Sarvam voice has the Cartesia default of its language and gender behind it. Marathi has Sarvam speakers but no Cartesia voice to back them, so none is added; Malayalam has no Bulbul v4 Flash speaker.
